name: Senpai wa Kouhai no Pantsu ga Shinpai Desu!
original_name: センパイはコウハイのパンツがシンパイですっ！
source: Minato and Nagi are preparing for their school Drama club's production of Cinderella, but Nagi only wants to talk about underwear.
translation: Minato and Nagi are preparing for their school Drama club's production of Cinderella, but Nagi only wants to talk about underwear.
